title: Gumball Pick Priority Over Geometry
description: Make gumball always priority over all elements in infinite world. Geometry currently blocks gumball interaction in procedural, cad, puzzle 3d.
summary: Gumball handles now win over occluding scene geometry in all infinite-world consumers (procedural, CAD, puzzle 3d). UnifiedGumball applies depth-biased raycast on handle meshes (same pattern as puzzle vortex pick priority), scans the full hit list for gumball handles at any depth, and starts drag/hover from window capture when a handle is under the cursor—even when closer geometry would otherwise steal R3F pointer events.
